rule: Read the whole case. Fill exactly one actor state and a source+actor note. Candidates are not approvals.

decisions.Kwic: 也不曾參請入室。一日法眼問云。則監院何不來入室。

decisions.Kwic: 及至洞山。却道麻三斤。

decisions.Kwic: 與他把手共行。他從來有放行手段。敢與爾入泥入水。同死同生。

decisions.Kwic: 常以啐啄之機。開示後學。善能應機說法。

decisions.Kwic: 大凡行脚人。須具啐啄同時眼。有啐啄同時用。方稱衲僧。

decisions.Kwic: 香林當時。也下語呈見解弄精魂。終不相契。

Decision.AttributionNote: Blue Cliff Record of Chan Master Foguo Yuanwu (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄). Yuanwu Keqin names Xianglin Chengyuan as the exact actor who offered words, displayed his understanding, and fooled with the spirit, but did not accord with Yunmen Wenyan.

decisions.Kwic: 耽源曰。咄。癡漢。誰在井中。仰山不契。

Decision.AttributionNote: Blue Cliff Record of Chan Master Foguo Yuanwu (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄). In the raised case, Danyuan Yingzhen is the exact speaker who shouts, 'Bah! Foolish fellow! Who is in the well?' to Yangshan Huiji.

decisions.Kwic: 於他七寸上。一揑揑住。便與老僧把手共行。

Decision.AttributionNote: Blue Cliff Record of Chan Master Foguo Yuanwu (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄), case twenty-seven. An unnamed monk asks about trees withered and leaves fallen; Yunmen Wenyan is the exact respondent who says, 'the body exposed in the golden wind' (體露金風).

decisions.Kwic: 僧問大隋。劫火洞然大千俱壞。未審這箇壞不壞隋云。壞僧云。恁麼則隨他去也隋云。隨他去。

Decision.AttributionNote: Blue Cliff Record of Chan Master Foguo Yuanwu (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄), case twenty-nine. After an unnamed monk asks whether it follows the ruined cosmos, Dasui Fazhen is the exact respondent who repeats, 'it follows it' (隨他去).

decisions.Kwic: 大死底人。都無佛法道理玄妙得失是非長短。到這裏只恁麼休去。

Decision.AttributionNote: Blue Cliff Record of Chan Master Foguo Yuanwu (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄). In his commentary on the Zhaozhou–Touzi case, Yuanwu Keqin says the greatly dead person has no Buddhist principles, marvels, gain or loss, right or wrong, long or short, and simply rests there.

decisions.Kwic: 垂示云。定乾坤句。萬世共遵。擒虎兕機。千聖莫辨。

Decision.AttributionNote: Blue Cliff Record of Chan Master Foguo Yuanwu (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄). Yuanwu Keqin supplies the case pointer: a phrase settling heaven and earth is honored for ten thousand generations, while a dynamic capturing tigers and rhinoceroses cannot be distinguished by a thousand sages.

decisions.Kwic: 直下更無纖翳。全機隨處齊彰。

Decision.AttributionNote: Blue Cliff Record of Chan Master Foguo Yuanwu (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄). In his case pointer, Yuanwu Keqin says there is directly not the slightest screen and the whole dynamic is displayed everywhere.

decisions.Kwic: 古人道。若向劍刃上走則快。若向情識上見則遲。

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: Yuanwu Keqin introduces the contrast with 古人道. The complete case, section, title, TEI metadata, and exact/parallel searches do not identify the old saying's original speaker, so it is retained as an impersonal quoted formula rather than reassigned to the later quoter.

Decision.AttributionNote: Blue Cliff Record of Chan Master Foguo Yuanwu (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄). Yuanwu Keqin quotes a source-unattributed old saying: going on the sword-edge is quick, while seeing from discriminating consciousness is slow; its original speaker is not reassigned to the later quoter.

decisions.Kwic: 其僧一似韓獹逐塊。連忙上階。捉其月影相似。又問。如何是無寒暑處。山云。寒時寒殺闍黎。熱時熱殺闍黎。如韓獹逐塊走到階上。又却不見月影。韓獹乃出戰國策。云韓氏之獹駿狗也。中山之兔狡兔也。是其獹方能尋其兔。

decisions.Kwic: 習學既盡。謂之絕學無為閑道人。及至絕學。方始與道相近。直得過此二學。是謂真過。

Decision.AttributionNote: Blue Cliff Record of Chan Master Foguo Yuanwu (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄), case forty-five. An unnamed monk is the exact questioner who asks, 'The ten thousand things return to one; where does the one return?' All six attribution rungs leave him unnamed; Zhaozhou Congshen gives the seven-cattie cloth-shirt answer.

decisions.Kwic: 雖然總是全機大用處。俱不如禾山解打鼓。

decisions.Kwic: 垂示云。要道便道。舉世無雙。當行即行。全機不讓。

Decision.AttributionNote: Blue Cliff Record of Chan Master Foguo Yuanwu (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄). In his case pointer, Yuanwu Keqin says: if you would speak, speak; if you would act, act; concede nothing of the whole dynamic.

decisions.Kwic: 三聖問雪峯。透網金鱗未審以何為食

decisions.Kwic: 頂門有眼方謂之透網金鱗。

decisions.Kwic: 殊不知鼻孔在別人手裏。

decisions.Kwic: 雪竇與南泉把手共行。一句說了也。

decisions.Kwic: 却被誌公云陛下還會麼。帝云。不會。誌公云。大士講經竟也。是一人作頭。一人作尾。誌公恁麼道。還夢見傅大士麼。

decisions.Kwic: 須是箇活鱍鱍漢。始得句句相投機機相應。

decisions.Kwic: 時有一禪客出云。大眾參堂去。這僧奪得主家權柄。道得也殺道。只道得八成。

Decision.AttributionNote: Blue Cliff Record of Chan Master Foguo Yuanwu (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄). An unnamed Chan visitor is the exact speaker who comes forward and says, 'Assembly, go to the hall.'
